image_description: A long, dimly lit interior corridor of a prison facility. The hallway features high concrete ceilings with exposed beams and hanging light fixtures. The walls are painted white on the upper half and a faded green on the lower half, separated by a chair rail. On both sides, there are heavy metal cell doors with small viewing slots. At the far end of the corridor, a large barred window or gate allows bright daylight to enter, casting strong shadows across the floor. A rusty metal gantry or walkway spans across the ceiling near the foreground.
